title: Prospective Life Cycle Optimization of Carbon Capture and Storage/Utilization (CCS/CCU) Supply Chains in the Cement Industry
summary: The title indicates a prospective life-cycle optimisation study of CCS and CCU supply chains serving the cement industry. The abstract is not yet available.
why_it_matters: Cement is a core capture source in Nordic CCS chains (e.g. Brevik, Aalborg Portland); a combined life-cycle and supply-chain optimisation model is directly comparable to network-design work on capture-transport-storage chains.
